statedAs.text: (1) For the purposes of section 11 (1) (c) of the Act, a person who hunts any of the following species must hold an uncancelled species licence for that species: (b) black bear;

(2) Section 5 (1) does not apply to a person in respect of a species if (a) a youth hunting licence is held on the person's behalf, and (b) the person is hunting with a supervising hunter who holds an uncancelled species licence for the species.

statedAs.text: (1) To be eligible for a species licence, a person must (a) hold a hunting licence, other than an initiation hunting licence or a youth hunting licence, and (b) if the person is a non-resident or non-resident alien, demonstrate that the person is to be accompanied by (i) a guide outfitter, (ii) an assistant guide issued a written authorization under section 48 (1.2) of the Act, or (iii) another person who holds a permit issued under section 70 (1) (a) of the Act that authorizes the other person to accompany the person who is the non-resident or non-resident alien.

requirements.kind: cancel species licence immediately after kill

statedAs.text: (1) If a person hunts and kills wildlife in respect of which the person is required to hold a species licence, the person commits an offence unless, immediately after killing the wildlife and before handling the wildlife killed, the person cancels the species licence in accordance with the instructions on that licence.

It is a condition of every hunting licence that the holder must not hunt wildlife unless the holder (a) carries, while hunting, each species licence issued to the holder during the term of the holder's hunting licence, whether or not any species licence has been cancelled, and (b) produces, on the request of an officer, all species licences referred to in paragraph (a).

unresolved: Applies to every hunting-licence holder while hunting any wildlife, including the six species that need no species licence, if the holder holds species licences for other species.

unresolved: 'upland game birds' is not defined in this regulation; B.C. Reg. 168/90 s. 14 (a) designates 'upland game birds' of the genera listed, which include Bonasa, Dendragapus (blue, spruce and Franklin grouse), Tympanuchus (sharp-tailed grouse) and Lagopus (willow, rock and white tailed ptarmigan). Snowshoe hare is not an upland game bird.

statedAs.text: It is a condition of every hunting licence that the holder must not hunt wildlife unless accompanied by a person described in section 17 (2) (a), (b) or (c) of the Act if the holder was, at the time the licence was issued, an unexamined non-resident or non-resident alien.
